qualification:
Replay every reached leaf's complete numeric inputs and output.
This is a source-control coupling certificate, not actual leaf installation.
ghost_constructor: #[cfg(kani)] impl<H: Digest32> SemanticTranscript<H> { pub fn proof_input(hash:H,state:[u8;32],next_row:u8)->Self { Self{state,hash,next_row} } }
leaf_port: push: all9 state u64 words +8 value u32 words +4 scalar u32 words, all9 output state words; finish: all9 state words; field: same exact slice pointer/length and ordered index
rejection_schedule: stop in0..=29: first Err at stop<29, or29 successful pushes; every possible first rejection is represented
remaining: Actual leaf interpretation and source/P6/caller transport; field aborts outside the fixed admitted928-byte input are not represented.
